help.title: How to use
help.intro: Inventory helps you remember where your things are: take a photo, say where you put it, and find it later in seconds.

start.title: Getting started
points: After you sign up, an administrator approves your account. Until then you only see "Your account is awaiting approval" after signing in; once approved, reload the page.
When signing up, pick "My language" (English, Русский or Español): the interface and your records will be in it. You can change it later in Settings.
The help opens with the "?" at the top of any screen — right on the matching section. Close it with the arrow or the Back gesture: everything you typed stays in place.
Install on iPhone: open the site in Safari → Share → "Add to Home Screen". On Android: Chrome → ⋮ → "Install app".
The browser asks for camera and microphone access the first time. Without a connection the app does not work: "Offline" shows at the top, saving and AI wait for it.

add.title: Add an item
points: Tap the camera at the bottom and choose "One item": take a photo or pick one from the gallery. The AI fills in the name, description, category and tags — check them and tap "Save".
An item can have up to 10 photos; the main one has a star, and you can change it. "Recognize again" asks the AI again about the main photo.
If the same photo was added before, the app shows those items before any AI request — you decide whether to add it again.
Photos are compressed on the phone; the location (GPS) and other data stored in the photo are removed. Take the item close up on a light background.

multi.title: Several items in one photo
points: On the Add screen choose "Several items in one photo" and photograph a shelf, a tool board or a drawer. The AI finds up to 30 items and cuts each out — one request.
In the list, untick what you don't need and fix names and categories. One place for all: "I'm here" by default.
Each item's main photo is its cut-out, the second is the whole picture. Items similar to ones you already have come unticked: you decide.

voice.title: Voice
points: In the item form, say where you put it: "in the garage on the rack at the cottage". If the place doesn't exist, the app asks "Create … inside …?"; if several fit, it asks you to choose.
In the same phrase you can say something about the item ("it's dad's old drill, broken"): changes to the name and description come as an "Accept / Decline" card.
Names and descriptions have a mic: speak, and the text appears under the field — "Replace", "Append to the end" or "Cancel". The text is always in the field's language.
Every voice recording is one AI request. Everything can be typed instead.

places.title: Places and "I'm here"
points: Places go inside each other: house → room → closet → shelf. Moved a closet to another room — move the place, and its items move with it. Only an empty place can be deleted.
"I'm here" is where new items go right away: choose it once and keep taking photos. It shows in the header, where you can change it or clear it with the cross.
There is one "I'm here" in the whole app: choosing a place while adding an item or in the Items filter changes it everywhere. "Move" on an item changes only that item's place.

items.title: Items and search
points: The Items tab opens on "I'm here" (with the places inside it). Filter by place and category; view as a photo gallery or a table.
On an item: "Edit", "Move" (from the list or by voice) and "Delete". The "←" arrow at the top goes back to the previous screen with the same filters.
Search: type a word — "drill". Smart search: tap the mic or "Ask AI" and ask "where is my drill?" — the AI finds similar words (one request).
Categories are there from the start, in your language: tools, kitchen, clothes and more. In Settings you can rename and delete them and add your own.

books.title: Books
points: Photograph the cover — the AI fills in the title (as printed), the author, and the year and ISBN if visible. Photograph the back cover with the barcode — the book is found in open catalogues without AI.

The ISBN is often inside the book: in the Book block tap "Scan ISBN" and photograph the copyright page. A barcode is looked for first; without one the AI reads the number (one request). This photo is not saved. You can also type the ISBN.
Once the ISBN is known, the app offers a catalogue cover: "Make it the main photo", "Add as the second photo" or "Not needed". For a saved book — "Find cover".
Photograph a shelf of books as "Several items": every book becomes a card. Books go to a "Books" category (if you have none, the app offers to create it); search finds authors and ISBNs.

bulk.title: Many items at once
points: In Items or in search results tap "Select" or press and hold an item. "Select all found" takes every item of the filters or the search, up to 500.
At the bottom: "Category", "Move" ("I'm here" first), "Delete" (with photos) and "Categorize".
"Categorize": the AI reads only the items' texts, no photos, and suggests categories. You see "was → will be" first — untick what you don't want and tap "Apply". 50 items — one request.
For 10 seconds after a change there is "Undo" at the bottom: every item goes back as it was. Deleting cannot be undone.

languages.title: Language
points: You choose "My language" when you sign up: English, Русский or Español. The interface and all your records — names, descriptions and tags of items, places and categories — are in it. You only see and type your own language.

An English version of names and descriptions is filled in by itself in the background. That's why search — plain, "Ask AI" and voice — looks in your language and in English: "дрель", "drill" and "taladro" find the same item. Accents don't matter: "camara" finds "cámara".
Speak in your language — voice works in all three.
Using Russian or Spanish and want to see English too? Settings → "Show English next to it": forms then have two fields, your language and English.

"My language" can be changed only in Settings → "Language". The interface and new records switch to it; records you already saved stay as they are and show in English until translated. The app offers to translate them now in the background (about 1 AI request per 40 records) or later: in Settings ("Not in your language: N") or with "Translate" on a record. The English version always stays.

plan.title: Plan and AI requests
points: Settings show your plan: how many items of the limit and how many AI requests in the last 24 hours. The administrator assigns the plan, sometimes until a date — after that it returns to Free by itself.

AI requests are used by: photo recognition, "Several items", voice, smart search, translation, "Categorize", reading an ISBN from a photo. Not used by: barcodes, book catalogues and covers, plain search, the repeat check.
When you have as many items as the plan allows, new items and every AI feature are off. Viewing, editing, searching and deleting still work; a lower plan deletes nothing.

account.title: Account
points: "Sign out" in Settings signs out of this device only; you stay signed in on others.
Delete the account: Settings → "Delete account", enter your password and the word DELETE. All places, items, categories and photos are deleted forever and cannot be restored.
